text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
In a card game, this would normally be 
against the rules, but—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Shall we go "peek at their hand," Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We've decided to skip the Satsuki Sho as 
planned. Instead—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I decide to conduct a thorough inspection 
on-site. Besides, Rulership is...
choice_data_list:
Are you going to watch from the reserved 
seats?

Are you going to watch from the reserved 
seats?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, looking down from above makes it 
much easier to see the whole board."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
There are some things you can never see up 
close. If you want to watch from below, 
feel free.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As expected, the race turned into a fierce 
battle.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaah--!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Splitting through the middle, Rose 
Kingdom! Rose Kingdom from the inside! 
However—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Victoire Pisa!! Victoire Pisa on the 
innermost rail!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Eishin Flash surges forward as well! But 
in the lead is Victoire Pisa!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's Victoire Pisa!! With winter's chill 
departed from Nakayama, an angel smiles—!!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Thank you... very much.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
The winner was... Pisa, huh. Slipping 
through the inside like that with such a 
packed final stretch...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"You couldn't pull that off without some 
serious resolve. Her guts are on another 
level."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
And at the start— not a single runner made 
an obvious mistake.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
None are as slow a starter as I. Is this 
what it means to live in the "now"?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your support. I'm so glad I 
was able to connect with the fans and my 
peers.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: The next one is the Japan Derby, right?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
From here, we'll expand our circle of 
racing even further. I'm looking forward 
to it, very much so.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, have we secured a foothold to build 
the Kingdom of Roses, then?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—33.0 seconds. Just a bit more—until I 
break through.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Still, after running against them, I felt 
it clearly... every single camp is 
undeniably a powerhouse.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"Flash-senpai, at this rate, the Japan 
Derby will likely turn into a fierce 
battle the likes of which history has 
rarely seen."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it will be a battle where a delay of 
even 0.01 seconds could prove fatal.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was already looking ahead to the 
next one. No—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even before the race, everyone might have 
already been looking toward what comes 
next. Even so—
choice_data_list:
This year... the field is insanely 
stacked...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The level of the other runners besides the 
favorites is remarkably high too. Years 
with a Classic Triple Crown this heated 
don't come around very often.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Man, I can't wait! On top of today's top 
runners, if new Umamusume join in too—

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! With such a star-studded lineup, 
this year's Japan Derby will undoubtedly—

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: It's the greatest Derby in history!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That night—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, today's race made it crystal 
clear to me.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Just focusing on the start and setting the 
pace nicely isn't enough to win the Japan 
Derby.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
There are plenty of Umamusume who excel at 
the gates. Even if I were to cover that 
area...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
My start will only ever be "average." I 
can't close the gap, and in the end, it 
won't be enough. That is why—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
We need a strategy. Something outside of 
the start that will overwhelmingly surpass 
the other Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Alright, time for a session, Trainer. 
We're going to come up with a 
game-changing strategy no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
A winning move that will decide 
everything. Our "Japanese Derby" has 
already begun.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two of us racked our brains. Even as 
the moon set and the sun rose, our 
strategy meeting continued endlessly.
